existing.description: Hungarian bilateral state scholarships are awarded under scientific and educational cooperation agreements signed by the governments of two countries, with the Hungarian side offering places to foreign students, researchers or lecturers in Hungarian higher education institutions and in scientific or art institutions. Tempus Public Foundation, a background organisation of the Hungarian Ministry of Culture and Innovation, is Hungary's national scholarship office. Applicants can apply either through nomination by their home country's national scholarship office or by submitting an individual application, and in both cases they must also submit into Tempus Public Foundation's online system. Applications undergo a formal eligibility check and are then scored by Tempus Public Foundation's external experts against several professional criteria.
eligibility: Be a foreign national studying, researching or lecturing at a Hungarian higher education institution or a scientific or art institution
Hold a place under a bilateral cooperation agreement between Hungary and the applicant's country
Either be nominated by the home country's national scholarship office, or submit an individual application into the Tempus Public Foundation online system
In the case of country nomination, the foreign partner office transmits its list of nominated scholars to Tempus Public Foundation
existing.eligibility_summary: Foreign students, researchers or lecturers nominated by a partner country's national scholarship office, or applying individually, who wish to study or carry out research in a Hungarian higher education institution or a scientific or art institution under a bilateral cooperation agreement.
requirements: Applications must be submitted into the Tempus Public Foundation online system in both routes
Country-nominated applicants must also apply through their national scholarship office
Applicants may not approach the host institution directly outside the Foundation's process
documents: Application submitted into the Tempus Public Foundation online system
For country-nominated applicants, the foreign partner office's nomination list
existing.english_requirement: courses but this is a simplification. Experts call the attention to the fact that internationalisation has a deeper meaning and should affect higher education in more fundamental aspects.
application_method: Route 1: submit an application to your own country's national scholarship office, which assesses it and prepares a nomination list, then also submit into the Tempus Public Foundation online system
Route 2: submit an individual application directly into the Tempus Public Foundation online system
After submission, applications undergo a formal eligibility check and are scored by Tempus Public Foundation external experts
Decisions are notified directly by email to applicants and, in the country-nomination case, to the national offices

existing.best_fit: Graduates and researchers from countries with a bilateral education or science cooperation agreement with Hungary who can obtain a place at a Hungarian institution, either via their national scholarship office or an individual application.
existing.duration: Full academic year (September - June); study visits up to 10 months
existing.application_period: No fixed dates published. Deadlines are set by each bilateral partner's national scholarship office for nominated applicants.
existing.deadline_display: No application deadline is published on the Tempus Public Foundation pages for bilateral state scholarships; applications are submitted into the Foundation's online system and assessed on a rolling basis per bilateral partner.
